answer: Key the bond to a hardware root so one device cannot back two identities. Step one, enrol the root and post the bond. Step two, sign each submission with a fresh nonce from that root. Step three, vest the reward over sixty epochs. The trade-off is portability, since a dead device strands the bond. A tundra station, a kernel build and a gale log from one root stay one identity, and a farm needs one physical device per clone.
